blocks.text: Let the Bush Furniture Salinas Hall Tree with Shoe Storage Bench welcome you home. Have a seat on top of the spacious entryway bench while you put on or take off your shoes. Four cubby shelves organize your entryway so you're not tripping over footwear when you walk in the door. Set your bags down on top of the Shoe Bench while you hang up your coat and get comfortable. The Hall Tree has three Tumbled Pewter double prong hooks to hold your family's jackets, scarves, hats and more. Available in your choice of seven attractive finish options, the country feel of the Hall Tree with Storage Bench looks great even beyond your entryway. Two adjustable shelves hold various items in any space, including a mudroom or hallway. Tapered legs, a curved base and decorative wood detailing with eye-catching vertical accents inspired by timeless Mission styling complement the casual homes of today. This entryway organizer is backed by the Bush Furniture 1 Year Manufacturer's Warranty. Complete your space with coordinating items from the Salinas Collection, including Living Room Tables, File and Storage Cabinets, Bookcases, Desks, Office Chairs and more.

items: Hall Tree features three double prong hooks for coats, scarves or other items
Shoe Bench has four open cubby shelves for organization and a spacious surface for bags or clothing
Two adjustable shelves create flexibility for storing footwear and other miscellaneous items
Top of Storage Bench is wide enough to sit on while putting on or taking off shoes and supports up to 250 pounds
Distressed finish options include a cream colored Antique White, Pure White with Shiplap Gray, Cape Cod Gray, Vintage Black, Ash Brown, Reclaimed Pine and Driftwood Gray
Perfect for an entryway, apartment, hallway, living room or anywhere storage is needed
Tapered legs, curved base rails and decorative wood accents inspired by timeless Mission styling
